map.：PRL>100 ng/mL 伴微腺瘤→多为泌乳素瘤（多巴胺激动剂一线）；GH: PRL > 100 ng/mL with a microadenoma points to a prolactinoma (dopamine agonists first line); elevated GH and IGF-1 with a sellar mass points to acromegaly (GH adenoma); a non-functioning macroadenoma is followed mainly on compression symptoms and visual field loss.
map.大腺瘤与小腺瘤怎么分？: How Are Large and Small Adenomas Distinguished?
map.以最大径 10 mm 为界；大腺瘤更易压迫视交叉与海绵窦，需评估视野与神经压迫。: Using 10 mm maximum diameter as the boundary; large adenomas are more likely to compress the optic chiasm and cavernous sinus, so visual field and neurological compression need assessment.
map.PRL 升高一定是瘤吗？: Does an Elevated PRL Always Mean a Tumor?
